title: Credit Policy: Unpaid Final Balances and Opening New Electric Service by Rate Schedule Accounts
content:
**Policy.** The cooperative reads the member's whole portfolio of Electric Service by Rate Schedule accounts before it opens or restores service.

1. **Opening a new account.** A new service account may be opened only when none of the member's final-billed service accounts carries an account balance above zero.
2. **Basis of the test.** The test reads the system record: the current account balance of every service account of the same member whose status is final billed. What the member says about an old balance does not replace that record.
3. **No offsetting.** A credit balance on one account never offsets a debit on another unless the member asks for the credit to be moved.
4. **Payment in full.** An unpaid final balance must be paid in full before the new account is opened; it is never carried onto the new account as a program charge.
5. **Reconnection.** A reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection follows the cooperative's reconnection conditions for that account, and in addition any other service account of the same member that is itself disconnected for nonpayment is reconnected only on its own payment, never on a payment made to a different account.

### Opening test — hypothetical portfolios

| Member's final-billed accounts (hypothetical) | New account may be opened |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| One final-billed account with a balance of $0.00 | Yes |
| One final-billed account with a balance of $0.01 | No |
| One final-billed account owing $64.20 and an active account with a $64.20 credit | No — the credit does not offset the debit unless the member asks for it to be moved |
| One final-billed account carrying a $12.00 credit balance | Yes — a credit is not a balance above zero |

### Questions answered by the policy

**Can an old final balance be added to the first bill of the new account?** No. It must be paid in full before the new account is opened.

**Does a payment on the member's home account reconnect the member's disconnected shop account?** No. Each account disconnected for nonpayment is reconnected only on its own payment.
